subject: BlockLight MAP: security gate sequencing & DPA/data-retention asks
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@blocklight.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: BlockLight Legal <legal@blocklight.com>
Date: Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 09:05 AM PDT
Subject: BlockLight MAP + security sequencing for POC

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the demo last week. Attached is our starter MAP (BlockLight_MAP_v1.xlsx) — it lays out business milestones and the security/compliance gates we need to clear before production: SOC 2 (Type II), SIG/CAIQ responses, a signed DPA, and explicit data-retention commitments for logs and request payloads. High-level asks:

- Can Redwood provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and confirm the last audit period?
- Can you complete SIG/CAIQ answers for the POC scope (we typically expect a CAIQ within 10 business days)?
- Are you open to the DPA redline I’ll attach from our counsel?
- For the POC we need: request payloads stored max 30 days, logs/metrics 180 days, EU residency for eu-region test data.

We’re targeting an internal readiness review the week of May 10 — would appreciate a proposed sequencing from your side so we can slot legal and security reviewers.

Attachments: [Attachment: BlockLight_MAP_v1.xlsx (38KB)]

—Elena
Elena Morales
Director, Infrastructure & Security
BlockLight
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@blocklight.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 11:12 AM PDT
Subject: Re: BlockLight MAP + security sequencing for POC

Elena — thanks for the MAP and clarity on the gating items. Rolling this to our security and legal leads; high-level proposal below so you can align your reviewers:

Proposed sequencing for the POC MAP (short-form)
1) POC deployment (non-prod, eu-region option) — immediate; smoke tests within 3 business days
2) SIG/CAIQ completion (POC scope only) — Redwood initial answers + gap notes within 7 business days
3) SOC 2 evidence package — redacted SOC 2 Type II report + control summary within 5 business days (we will mark sensitive items redacted)
4) DPA execution — Redwood proposes a focused redline that preserves PII protections and KMS controls; can start legal exchange concurrently with SIG work
5) Production readiness review — target week of May 10 as you suggested

Data-retention: we can accept the POC defaults you listed with two clarifications:
- Request payloads: 30 days for persisted payloads, 7 days for ephemeral request traces (configurable)
- Logs/metrics: 180 days for aggregated logs; audit trail exports can be retained up to 2 years if needed for compliance by written exception

I’ve attached our starter responses and a filled MAP worksheet for you to review. Neha/Jonas — can you confirm internal SLA on CAIQ and SOC artifacts? Kimberly — looping in legal for DPA coordination.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_MAP_response.xlsx (46KB)]

Thanks,
Priyom
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, Apr 21, 2027 at 09:22 AM PDT
Subject: Re: BlockLight MAP + security sequencing for POC

Team — quick operational notes for the thread:

- SIG/CAIQ: I’ll run a scoped CAIQ for the POC surfaces (ingest, inference, logging) and deliver a first-pass PDF with narrative answers in 7 business days (by Tue, Apr 29). We’ll flag any control gaps and recommended mitigations.
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for the period Apr 2026–Apr 2027. We can circulate a redacted copy and a 1-page control summary by Apr 27.
- DPA: Kimberly — recommend we propose these redlines up-front: 30-day payload retention (POC), 180-day logs, KMS BYOK optionality, and EU data residency for the eu-region sandbox. I’ll note where we can be flexible vs. standard policy items.

I’ll attach the CAIQ export and a short gap log to the next message.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 11:34 AM PDT
Subject: Re: BlockLight MAP + security sequencing for POC — proposed dates and deliverables

Elena / BlockLight team — thanks for the initial MAP. Per internal alignment here’s a consolidated timeline and deliverables so your legal and security reviewers can slot the checkpoints:

Deliverables & target dates
- Apr 27: Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (period Apr 2026–Apr 2027) + 1-page control summary (Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_snapshot_redacted.pdf)
- Apr 29: SIG/CAIQ scoped answers (POC scope) + CAIQ gap log (Attachment: Redwood_CAIC_answers_v1.pdf)
- May 03: Redwood proposed DPA redline uploaded (Attachment: Redwood_DPA_proposal_redline.pdf) and DocuSign link: https://docusign.example/BL-DPA-2027
- Week of May 10: Joint production-readiness review (final sign-off window)

Notes / exceptions
- Data residency: we will deploy eu-region sandbox for EU test data; production residency options discussed post-POC
- Retention defaults: request payloads 30 days (POC), logs/metrics 180 days. Exceptions beyond that will require written approval and a signed data addendum.
- Attachments include our MAP response and the CAIQ snapshot. We will not include full unredacted evidence in initial deliveries; access can be provided under NDA/secure sharing if deeper evidence review is required.

Next steps: Elena — can you confirm the readiness review meeting window that best suits your security and legal (May 10–14 or May 17–21)? Also please confirm who at BlockLight will own the DPA redline exchange (I see legal@blocklight.com on cc).

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_MAP_response.xlsx (46KB); Attachment: Redwood_CAIC_answers_v1.pdf (112KB); Attachment: Redwood_DPA_proposal_redline.pdf (28KB)]

—Priyom
